title: Otter with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='42' ry='9' fill='#2fd4ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='35' ry='6' fill='#7fe9ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#a86b32'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#e0b57a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#b8743a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='26' r='7' fill='#8f5527'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='26' r='7' fill='#8f5527'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='26' r='4' fill='#c98c55'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='26' r='4' fill='#c98c55'/>
  <!-- face muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#e8c48e'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='40' rx='6' ry='6.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='40' rx='6' ry='6.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='38' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- star sparkles -->
  <path d='M46 32 l1 2.5 2.5 1 -2.5 1 -1 2.5 -1 -2.5 -2.5 -1 2.5 -1z' fill='#fff36b'/>
  <path d='M56 30 l0.8 2 2 0.8 -2 0.8 -0.8 2 -0.8 -2 -2 -0.8 2 -0.8z' fill='#fff36b'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#3a2015'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='46' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#7a5040'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 50 q-4 4 -8 2' stroke='#7a4a22' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 50 q4 4 8 2' stroke='#7a4a22' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='48' x2='38' y2='49' stroke='#c99a66' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='52' x2='38' y2='51' stroke='#c99a66' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='48' x2='62' y2='49' stroke='#c99a66' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='52' x2='62' y2='51' stroke='#c99a66' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws on belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#c98c55'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='72' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#c98c55'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M70 80 q14 6 10 16 q-3 6 -10 2 q-6 -4 -6 -10z' fill='#8f5527'/>
</svg>
